description: CPT procedure codes with elevated denial risk. Based on common prior-auth requirements and bundling rules.

prior_auth_required.description: Procedures requiring prior authorization from most payers. Missing auth = near-certain denial.

bundling_risk.description: Codes frequently denied for bundling — payer considers them included in another service billed same day.

medical_necessity_scrutiny.description: Codes subject to heightened medical necessity review. Diagnosis must clearly support service.

frequency_limit_risk.description: Codes with payer-imposed frequency limits — billing too often triggers denial.
